_comment: Live Claude Code subscription accounts for the orchastrator backend running on Harsh's machine. Each backend (machine/VM) declares which account_id it's currently using in backends.json (one level up).
_tier_note: tier must be one of: pro, max5, max20, team, enterprise, api. Edit `tier` + `weekly_msg_limit` to match the actual subscription.
_integration_note: This is the operator-edited source of truth. The orchastrator backend reads it via ORCHASTRATOR_ACCOUNTS env var (see ../../orchastrator/scripts/dev.sh integration).
